methodology: A reviewer split each answer into atomic factual claims, mapped every claim to a literal answer quote, attested exhaustive coverage of material factual claims, checked each claim against the current query image plus the cited knowledge-base page, and recorded whether the answer explicitly rejected insufficient evidence. Subjective style commentary is not treated as a factual claim. Reviews are bound to the exact answer SHA-256 so they cannot be reused after output changes.
